propositions: Multiple review passes on the same work item reveal that coaching moves address instances rather than populations, allowing authors to iteratively add single items without recognizing the systemic enumeration failure.
A new registry move must reframe named instances as population samples and require machine-checkable completeness proof via acceptance criteria like grep patterns to force exhaustive enumeration.

The new move should be scoped via applies_when to criteria where populations actually exist: G1G2, E4, G6, and A1 in the plan-review gate, keeping it additive and separate from existing generalization move 12.
The move entry must include exact template text with one {subject} placeholder, be indexed as key 15 in MOVE_REGISTRY, and be mirrored in the docs move table to pass existing validation tests.
